title: Nachemson & Evans 1968 L3-L4 ligamentum flavum resting force
condition: autopsy, mixed ages and disc grades

quantity.name: resting force
quantity.definition: in situ tensile force of LF in neutral position (from load needed to restore in situ length)

source.sample: 10 L3-L4 ligamenta flava from 10 autopsy cadavers (8 tested as separated left/right halves, 2 whole); human lumbar ligamentum flavum, L3-L4 interlaminar portion

protocol.summary: Resting (in situ) length measured between laminar drill holes before and after separating vertebral bodies (contraction = prestrain). Interlaminar LF portions (articular processes removed), laminae wired to grips; optical extensometer on marker pins at bone-ligament junction; Instron in buffered isotonic Ringer at 37 C; strain rate ~0.33 /min; 5 load cycles to 1 kg then 2 kg, relaxation tests, then to rupture.
how_to_simulate: Model the L3-L4 ligamentum flavum with its in situ resting (pre)strain
Apply uniaxial tension along the cranio-caudal fibre direction at ~0.33 /min (quasi-static) to rupture
Report prestrain/resting force in neutral posture, final (rupture) modulus, rupture stress and strain
